error_conflict: The action cannot be completed because it conflicts with the current data.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
error_internal_error: A server error occurred. Try again.
error_method_not_allowed: The request method is not supported.
error_not_found: The requested data was not found.
error_not_implemented: This feature is not available yet.
error_upgrade_required: The server cannot process this request.
login_error: Could not sign in with this account.
login_inactive: This account is inactive. Contact an administrator.
login_intro: Use your work account to access the KRAN back office.
login_locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later or contact an administrator.
param_error_branch_not_allowed: Your permissions do not cover this value's branch (or this action is not allowed at institution level).
param_error_effective_from_invalid: Effective-from date is invalid. Use the YYYY-MM-DD format.
param_error_effective_to_invalid: Effective-to date is invalid. Use the YYYY-MM-DD format.
param_error_effective_to_without_success: An effective-to date requires a replacement value that is valid on that date.
param_error_invalid_combination: This value conflicts with another active parameter.
param_error_period_invalid: The effective-to date must be after the effective-from date.
param_error_scope_id_forbidden: The GLOBAL scope must not include a specific scope id.
param_error_scope_id_required: This scope requires a scope id (scopeId).
param_error_scope_not_readable: You are not authorized to submit a value for this scope.
param_error_value_invalid: The value does not match the parameter definition (type, range, or scope).
params_pending_empty: No change is waiting for approval.
params_submit_effective_from_hint: Leave empty to use today's business date.
params_submit_success: Change recorded and waiting for approval.
password_error_policy: The new password does not meet the policy.
password_hint: Must differ from your username and contain no spaces.
password_intro: The initial password only works for the first sign-in. Change it now, before you start working.
password_required_notice: Change your password before you start working.
password_success: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.
ledger_intro: Balances per account for the selected period. Figures come from journals; the currency symbol lives in the column heading.
ledger_empty: No journals in this period yet.
ledger_empty_hint: Post a journal, or choose another period.
teller_intro: Deposits, withdrawals, and account-to-account transfers for savings accounts.
teller_account_id_hint: Paste the destination account ID (UUID). Destination account number lookup is not available yet.
teller_account_no_input_hint: Enter the account number from the passbook or receipt.
teller_account_lookup_not_found: Account not found. Check the number, or confirm the account is within your branch authority.
teller_account_none_hint: Open this page with an accountId parameter, or paste the account ID and load it.
teller_transaction_need_account: Load an account before posting a transaction.
teller_amount_hint: Digits only, no thousands separator. Example: 150000 or 150000.00.
teller_review_balance: Balance when loaded {time}: {balance}. This figure is a snapshot from when the account was loaded.
teller_reference_hint: The reference is created before the transaction is sent and reused when you retry. Keep it if the response is uncertain.
teller_denied: This account is not allowed to post cash transactions.
teller_not_found: Account not found. Check the account ID.
teller_error_account_invalid: Account ID must be a UUID. Check the pasted value.
teller_error_amount_format: Amount may only contain digits and at most one decimal separator.
teller_error_amount_zero: Amount must be greater than zero.
teller_error_amount_precision: Amount may have at most 2 decimal places.
teller_error_narration_too_long: Note may be at most 200 characters.
teller_error_destination_invalid: Destination account must be a UUID.
teller_error_destination_same: The destination account must differ from the source account.
teller_error_insufficient_funds: Insufficient balance for this withdrawal. The transaction was not saved. Check the balance, then change the amount.
teller_error_period_closed: The accounting period is closed. The transaction was not saved. Ask an admin about the current period.
teller_error_account_not_active: The account is not active. The transaction was not saved.
teller_error_branch_not_allowed: This account is outside your branch authority. The transaction was not saved.
teller_error_no_open_session: No cash session is open. Open a cash session first.
teller_error_session_business_date_misma: A cash session from another business date is still open. Close it first, then open today's session.
teller_error_unknown_state: The transaction status is unknown. Do not retry with a different amount. Keep the reference, then check the account statement.
teller_session_blocked_error: The cash session status is not confirmed. Reload the session before posting a transaction.
teller_session_blocked_loading: The cash session is loading. Wait a moment before posting a transaction.
teller_session_branch_not_allowed: This account's branch is outside your authority. The cash session cannot be opened or closed.
teller_session_close_review_hint: The server computes expected cash and the difference when the session closes.
teller_session_counted_cash_hint: Physical cash counted in the drawer. May be 0.
teller_session_denied: This account is not allowed to open or close cash sessions.
teller_session_error_already_closed: This cash session is already closed. Reload to see the running session.
teller_session_error_already_open: A cash session is still open. Close it first, then open a new one.
teller_session_error_counted_required: Enter the counted cash first. It may be 0.
teller_session_error_float_required: Enter the opening float first. It may be 0.
teller_session_error_insufficient_vault: The branch vault balance is too low for this opening float. Lower the opening float, or ask an admin to fund the vault.
teller_session_error_not_found: Cash session not found. Reload the session.
teller_session_error_not_owned: This cash session belongs to another teller. Only your own session can be closed.
teller_session_error_unknown_state: The cash session status is unknown. Keep the reference, then reload the session once the connection is back.
teller_session_error_vault_missing: The branch vault is not configured. Ask an admin before opening a session.
teller_session_need_account: Load an account first. The cash session is loaded for that account's branch.
teller_session_none: No cash session is open for this branch.
teller_session_open_announcement: Cash session opened for business date {date}.
teller_session_opening_float_hint: Cash in the drawer at start. May be 0.
